en: The image depicts a stylized monument with a statue of a knight or warrior in armor holding a sword, standing atop a pedestal. The monument is flanked by two other statues and features a prominent double-headed eagle with a shield and insignia. Below the monument, there is text in a Slavic script and a date. The background includes architectural elements, such as a clock tower and classical buildings, rendered in an art-deco style.
